endorsements.name: Piñero Laorden
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-40677
endorsements.description: SQL injection vulnerability in Summar Software´s Portal del Empleado. This vulnerability allows an attacker to retrieve, create, update, and delete the database by sending a POST request using the parameter “ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$filtroNombre” in “/MemberPages/quienesquien.aspx”.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)
